snippet.title: Buloki: Escape from the Alien Ship - Trailer
snippet.description:
Buloki has been abducted by aliens! Master grid-based movement, don't fall, avoid traps and patrolling aliens, and find your way out of the ship.

This challenging puzzle game is a mashup of Bloxorz and Pac-Man.

It's my first commercial game, and I hope you'll enjoy playing it as much as I enjoyed making it!

The game is available here: https://crowsidegames.itch.io/buloki-escape-from-the-alien-ship
